datasets.name: Landslide inventory of Eastern Iburi
datasets.source: Geographical Survey Institute (GSI) of Japan and Zhang et al. (2019)
datasets.verbatim: The landslide inventory map in this region is generated by the Geographical Survey Institute (GSI) of Japan using aerial ortho-photographs42. Zhang et al.43 updated the landslide inventory map by performing spatial analyses on VHR aerial images and a 10-m resolution DEM.

datasets.name: Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery
datasets.verbatim: The training and testing areas are presented on Sentinel-2 images, band combination 1–2–3 (https:// scihub. coper nicus. eu/).

methods.name: U-Net and Residual U-Net (ResU-Net)
methods.summary: The authors adapted U-Net and ResU-Net architectures for landslide detection using Sentinel-2 optical bands and ALOS DEM data. The U-Net consists of a contracting encoder and expanding decoder with skip connections, while the ResU-Net incorporates residual learning blocks and batch normalization to improve training performance and mitigate vanishing gradients.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is referenced but not linked, and other input datasets are accessible. The custom code used for the U-Net and ResU-Net methods is not provided via any repository or persistent link.
